storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: Iran has dismissed claims that it is plotting a 'dirty bomb' attack on Washington, labeling the reports as baseless. US officials are reportedly debating the credibility of these allegations, while Trump stated that his administration is taking the threat seriously, despite the White House asserting there are currently no credible threats. Trump has issued a warning to Iran regarding these allegations.
